prose: The stellar scholar and prolific author David Warner Mathisen joins InnerVerse to discuss the ancient universal system, codified in the stars above. Join us as we explore the origins of all myths, religious texts, and perhaps even some star stories that are disguised as "ancient history."
ext: We discuss the Hercules constellation, chaos, and the storm gods of the world. We also get into a deep speculation about what the technology of star myth might mean about the nature of the universe, and the possibility of great cycles in which consciousness expands and contracts.
links: David Warner Mathisen, Star Myth World
